jobs.title: Director of Partnerships
jobs.description:
🌐 WHO WE ARE

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.



💼 The Role

We are looking for a Director of Partnerships to build and grow Bankjoy's channel partnership ecosystem, driving revenue through relationships with core banking partners, resellers, and referral networks that connect us with credit unions and community banks nationwide.

This role is primarily a pipeline generation role. Your success is measured by the volume and quality of leads you bring in through channel partners and the revenue those leads produce. You will work closely with Sales and Marketing to ensure every lead is handed off effectively and every partner relationship is nurtured for long-term productivity.

The ideal candidate is a relationship-driven, commercially minded partnerships professional with deep roots in the fintech or banking technology ecosystem. You know how to identify the right partners, build trust with their teams, structure mutually beneficial arrangements, and keep those relationships active and productive over time.




🧠 What You'll Do

Channel Partnership Development

 - Identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners, including core banking system providers, resellers, referral networks, and fintech ecosystem players, that can generate qualified leads for Bankjoy

 - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of inbound leads sourced through channel partnerships, with a focus on credit unions and community banks

 - Structure partnership agreements that create clear, measurable incentives for partners to actively refer and resell Bankjoy's platform

 - Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business, client base, and goals so you can position Bankjoy as a natural fit within their ecosystem

Partner Relationship Management

 - Serve as the primary relationship owner for Bankjoy's channel partners, maintaining regular touchpoints, tracking engagement levels, and keeping partners informed on Bankjoy's product roadmap and wins

 - Proactively nurture partner relationships to ensure they remain active and productive over time, not just at signing.

 - Represent Bankjoy at industry conferences, partner events, and credit union forums to strengthen existing relationships and develop new ones

 - Manage a small number of resell/referral partnerships where Bankjoy refers clients to complementary vendors, ensuring those relationships are maintained appropriately

Sales & Marketing Collaboration

 - Work closely with the Sales team to ensure channel-sourced leads are handed off cleanly, followed up on promptly, and tracked through to close

 - Partner with Marketing to develop co-marketing materials, webinars, joint campaigns, and partner-facing content that generates awareness and drives referrals

 - Provide Sales with context on each partner and lead to improve conversion rates and shorten sales cycles

 - Maintain accurate pipeline reporting across all channel sources so leadership has clear visibility into partnership-driven revenue contribution

Strategic Contribution

 - Build and own Bankjoy's channel partnership strategy, identifying which partner categories represent the highest ROI and prioritizing accordingly

 - Track partnership performance metrics and continuously optimize the partner mix based on lead volume, lead quality, and revenue outcomes

 - Contribute to Bankjoy's broader go-to-market strategy by surfacing market intelligence and partner insights that inform product and sales priorities



🎯 What You Bring

 - 5+ years of channel partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances experience, specifically within fintech, banking technology, or financial services.

 - Established relationships within the credit union or community banking ecosystem. Familiarity with core banking providers (Corelation, Jack Henry, Fiserv, CU*Answers, or similar) is a strong advantage

 - Proven track record of building and growing channel partnerships that generate measurable revenue. You can point to specific partners you recruited and the pipeline they produced

 - Strong commercial instincts: you understand how to structure partnerships that create genuine mutual value and keep partners motivated to refer

 - Excellent relationship management skills. You are proactive, responsive, and known for keeping partnerships warm and productive over the long term

 - Experience working closely with Sales teams to ensure seamless lead handoff and follow-through

 - Comfortable operating in a high-growth, resource-constrained environment where you're expected to build the playbook, not just run it

 - Strong communicator, able to represent Bankjoy credibly with partner executives and at industry events



🌟 Nice to Have

 - Existing relationships with CU*Answers, Fiserv Portico, Corelation, or Jack Henry Symitar partner networks

 - Experience structuring and managing reseller or white-label partnership agreements

 - Familiarity with digital banking platforms and the competitive landscape for credit unions and community banks

 - Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) to manage partner pipeline and track revenue attribution




🎁 WHAT YOU GET

 - A fast-paced and collaborative environment 

 - Competitive compensation

 - Stock options at a well-funded startup

 - We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA). 

 - We cover 100% of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family under our single, comprehensive plan (Canada).

 - Retirement plan with 4% company matching 

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing

 - 3-5 weeks PTO depending on tenure

 - 5 health days

 - 15 holidays

 - End of year shutdown

 - Performance-based bonuses 

 - Remote first culture
   
    


⚖️ EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITIES AT BANKJOY

Bankjoy is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds for all of its tech, non-tech, and leadership roles. Bankjoy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

jobs.title: Senior Human Resources Manager
jobs.description:
🌐 WHO WE ARE

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior HR Manager who genuinely loves the craft of HR — the day-to-day work of making sure people are set up to succeed, policies are followed, and the organization runs smoothly. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role, not a strategic advisory one.

You will be the primary HR operator at Bankjoy — owning onboarding, offboarding, employee relations, performance management, benefits, compliance, and HR systems end to end. You take pride in the details, you follow through, and you find satisfaction in building processes that actually work in practice. You are equally comfortable having a difficult conversation with a manager about a performance issue and helping a new hire get their laptop set up.

This role reports to the COO and works closely with our Senior Talent Acquisition Partner on recruiting coordination. If you are looking for a role that is primarily strategy and frameworks, this is not the right fit. If you want to be the person who makes HR work at a fast-growing fintech — and genuinely enjoys that — read on.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO 

HR Operations — Own It End to End

 - Run a clean, consistent onboarding experience for every new hire — across US and Canadian employees and contractors — using Rippling as the system of record

 - Own offboarding end to end — access revocation, device return, Carta/equity cleanup, final pay, and departing employee system removal, all tracked and completed without gaps

 - Maintain employee records, org charts, and HR data in Rippling with a high standard of accuracy

 - Manage benefits administration for US and Canadian employees — open enrollment, carrier coordination, employee questions, and policy accuracy

 - Handle basic IT support tasks — password resets, device setup and return coordination, Google Workspace access management, and new hire hardware procurement in partnership with our IT specialist

 - Own Bankjoy's SOC II HR security policy — maintaining HR evidence for our annual audit, keeping security policies current, and ensuring employee compliance with IT security requirements

Performance Management

 - Administer Bankjoy's performance review cycles in Lattice — configuring review templates, managing timelines, supporting managers through the process, and ensuring reviews are completed on time

 - Provide hands-on coaching to managers on setting expectations with direct reports, documenting performance concerns, and conducting accountability conversations — practical guidance, not just frameworks

 - Support managers in building and documenting performance improvement plans (PIPs) when needed, ensuring the process is fair, consistent, and legally sound

 - Track and flag performance concerns that are escalating — you are the early warning system, not the last resort

Manager Training

 - Deliver practical, live manager training sessions on the specific capability gaps that matter most at Bankjoy: setting expectations, accountability conversations, hiring well, and retaining high performers

 - Track whether training is working — follow up with managers on action items, measure behavior change, and report outcomes to the COO monthly

 - Coordinate with external training providers for specialized programs (e.g., annual leadership development) — own the vendor relationship, logistics, and follow-through

Policy, Compliance & Employee Relations

 - Maintain and enforce Bankjoy's HR policies — PTO submission, sick day process, remote work standards, and documentation requirements — ensuring managers and employees are following them consistently

 - Serve as the first point of contact for employee relations matters — handling questions, concerns, and workplace issues with fairness, discretion, and good judgment

 - Ensure Bankjoy stays compliant with employment laws

 - Keep the Employee Handbook current — updating policies as laws change and communicating changes clearly to the team

HR Systems & Tools

 - Own Rippling as the system of record — onboarding/offboarding workflows, automations, reporting, and data integrity

 - Manage Lattice for performance reviews, 1:1 tracking, and employee development records

 - Support recruiting coordination in Ashby — interview scheduling, candidate communications, offer letter logistics — in partnership with the Senior Talent Acquisition Partner

 - Comfortable learning and operating new tools without needing IT support for every step — you figure things out

Compensation & Benefits

 - Prepare comp recommendations for new hires and promotions with market benchmarks and internal equity checks — grounded in Bankjoy's budget reality, not just market ideals

 - Administer the annual compensation review process — pulling data, flagging equity issues, and presenting costed options to the COO

 - Manage benefits renewals and open enrollment for US and Canadian employees — coordinating with carriers and ensuring employees have what they need

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5–8 years of HR experience in a hands-on generalist or HR manager role — at a startup, scaleup, or similarly lean environment where you owned multiple functions simultaneously

 - Genuinely hands-on by nature — you find satisfaction in doing the work well, not in delegating it. You don't need a team under you to feel effective.

 - Strong working knowledge of Canada and US employment law basics across a distributed workforce

 - Proven experience with performance management — you have had the difficult conversations, written the PIPs, and supported managers through terminations

 - Tech-savvy and systems-oriented — you pick up new HR tools quickly, build Rippling automations without being asked, and maintain clean data without being reminded

 - Experience with onboarding and offboarding at scale — you have built the checklists, run the process, and closed the gaps

 - SOC II or similar compliance experience — you understand what HR evidence looks like for a security audit and can own it independently

 - Strong employee relations instincts — you know how to handle a sensitive situation with discretion, care, and good judgment

 - Excellent organizational skills — you run multiple things simultaneously without dropping balls, and you follow through without being chased

 - Comfortable with IT basics — password resets, Google Workspace administration, device coordination. You are not intimidated by these tasks.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience at a fintech, SaaS, or technology company — ideally one that was Series A to Series C stage

 - Experience supporting a US and Canadian distributed workforce simultaneously

 - Familiarity with Rippling, Lattice, Ashby, Checkr, or Vanta

 - CHRP designation or equivalent Canadian HR certification

 - Experience coordinating with external training vendors for manager development programs

 

Compensation

 - Base Salary: $90,000 – $120,000 CAD

 - Performance Bonus: Up to 10% of base salary annually

 - Equity: Stock options in a high-growth fintech company




🎁 WHAT YOU GET

 - A fast-paced and collaborative environment 

 - Competitive compensation

 - Stock options at a well-funded startup

 - We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA). 

 - We cover 100% of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family under our single, comprehensive plan (Canada).

 - Retirement plan with 4% company matching 

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing

 - 3-5 weeks PTO depending on tenure

 - 5 health days

 - 15 holidays

 - End of year shutdown

 - Performance-based bonuses 

 - Remote first culture
